## Checklist

- [ ] Pages follow [the template](../templates/page-template.md) and have at least one diagram with a caption
- [ ] Breadcrumb, "On this page" list and footer are present (`python scripts/build_nav.py` adds the breadcrumb and footer)
- [ ] `python scripts/build_nav.py --check` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/check_links.py` passes
- [ ] `cd examples && pytest` passes (no API key needed)
- [ ] New terms are in [GLOSSARY.md](../GLOSSARY.md) and linked on first use
- [ ] Difficulty badge and reading time are set
- [ ] Facts are sourced; no copied text or images
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under CC BY 4.0 (content) and MIT (code)
